desc:
⚔️ Build your army. Start the battle. Watch the chaos unfold.

Choose from tons of different troops, build formations, and create your own battles with everything from knights and wizards to tanks, helicopters and animals. 🏹💥🐶

🎯 Play campaign battles and beat enemy armies  
🧱 Build your own army in Sandbox  
👥 Fight other players in multiplayer  
🚁 Unlock crazy troops, vehicles and special units  
🔥 Watch huge battles with explosions, magic, ragdolls and destruction  
🧠 Experiment with formations, counters and different strategies

Want to see if 100 geese can beat a tank? Go for it. 🪿

New troops, maps and features coming regularly!
